turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Upset isn't the word. Who entered the zero, and did anyone call me first?
But I'm not changing the grade.
"Not changing the grade." On what basis, Hale? And your own procedure says a parent gets a call before any mark is entered.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.
I'm not here to keep going. You asked for this meeting, so what do you have besides a zero?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
Then I'll say it once, in writing, to the principal. Before I do, is "no" all you have, or is there a document?
